name: type:chore
description: Tooling, deps, refactor. No user-visible change

name: status:draft
description: Parked. No agent runs. Add status:needs-triage to start

name: status:needs-info
description: Issue incomplete. PO edits issue to re-trigger triage

name: status:needs-plan
description: Architect agent writes an implementation plan

name: status:plan-review
description: Plan posted. Human approves or requests changes

name: status:blocked
description: Agent failed or is stuck. Human needed

name: pr:auto-merge
description: Low risk. Merges automatically when CI is green

name: pr:human-review
description: Needs a human approval before merge

name: breaking-change
description: Breaks content or URLs. Forces plan + human review
